touch on a topic: In today's lecture, the professor will only briefly touch on a topic we will study in detail next week.
在今天的課上，教授只會簡短提及一個我們下週會詳細研讀的主題。
touch someone's heart: The story of the old man and his loyal dog touched the heart of everyone in the audience.
那位老人和他忠狗的故事感動了在場每位觀眾的心。
touch base with: I'll touch base with you next week to see how the science project is going.
我下週會跟你聯繫，看看科展專題進行得如何。
lose touch: After moving to Canada, I started to lose touch with many of my elementary school friends.
搬到加拿大後，我開始和許多小學朋友失聯。
touch up a photo: She likes to touch up a photo before posting it online, removing pimples and brightening the colors.
她喜歡在把照片貼上網前先修圖，去掉痘痘並把顏色調亮。
touch a nerve: His joke about her weight touched a nerve, and she left the party without saying goodbye.
他拿她體重開的玩笑觸到了她的痛處，她沒說再見就離開了派對。
touch off a riot: The police officer's violent arrest of a teenager touched off a riot in the city center.
警察暴力逮捕一名青少年，在市中心引發了暴動。
the finishing touch: As the finishing touch, Grandma placed a fresh strawberry on top of the birthday cake.
奶奶在生日蛋糕頂端放上一顆新鮮草莓，作為畫龍點睛的一筆。
tour the country: After releasing their new album, the band plans to tour the country and perform in twelve cities.
發行新專輯後，這個樂團計畫巡迴全國，在十二個城市演出。
tour the factory: Our class visited the chocolate company and got to tour the factory to see how candy is made.
我們班參訪那家巧克力公司，還參觀了工廠，看糖果是怎麼做的。
tour with a band: My cousin quit his office job to tour with a band as their guitar player across Asia.
我表哥辭掉辦公室工作，以吉他手身分隨樂團在亞洲巡演。
a guided tour: We joined a guided tour of the old castle, and the guide told us many interesting stories.
我們參加了古堡的導覽，導遊跟我們講了許多有趣的故事。
on tour: The famous singer is on tour in Europe this summer, so she won't be back in Taiwan until October.
那位知名歌手今年夏天在歐洲巡迴中，所以要到十月才會回台灣。
tow a car: A truck came to tow a car that had broken down in the middle of the highway.
一輛卡車來拖走一台在高速公路中間拋錨的車。
in tow: The teacher arrived at the museum with thirty excited students in tow behind her.
老師抵達博物館，身後跟著三十個興奮的學生。
tow the line: If you want to keep working here, you have to tow the line and follow the company's rules.
如果你想繼續在這裡工作，就必須服從並遵守公司的規定。
be towed away: If you park in front of the fire station, your car will be towed away immediately.
如果你把車停在消防局前面，你的車會立刻被拖吊。
trace one's roots: Many Americans travel to Europe to trace their roots and visit the villages where their ancestors lived.
許多美國人到歐洲追溯根源，造訪他們祖先曾居住的村莊。
trace the development: This museum exhibition traces the development of Taiwanese pop music from the 1960s to today.
這個博物館展覽追溯台灣流行音樂從1960年代到今日的發展。
trace a call: The police were able to trace a call to an apartment near the train station.
警方成功追蹤來電，查到火車站附近的一間公寓。
trace the outline: The little girl put her hand on the paper and used a pencil to trace the outline of her fingers.
小女孩把手放在紙上，用鉛筆描出她手指的輪廓。
trace the source: Health officials managed to trace the source of the food poisoning to a breakfast shop near the school.
衛生官員成功追溯食物中毒的來源，查到學校附近的一家早餐店。
vanish without trace: The hiker seemed to vanish without trace, and rescue teams searched the mountain for weeks.
那位登山客似乎消失無蹤，搜救隊在山上搜尋了好幾個星期。
trace back to: The custom of eating rice dumplings can be traced back to an ancient poet in China.
吃粽子的習俗可以追溯到中國一位古代詩人。
track progress: This app lets students track progress in vocabulary learning and see how many words they have mastered.
這個應用程式讓學生追蹤單字學習的進度，看看自己已經掌握多少字。
track down a suspect: It took the police three days to track down a suspect who had stolen several scooters.
警方花了三天才追查到一名偷了好幾台機車的嫌犯。
lose track of time: When I play video games, I often lose track of time and forget to do my homework.
我打電動時常常忘了時間，而忘記寫作業。
be on the right track: Your answer isn't perfect yet, but you are on the right track, so keep trying.
你的答案還不完美，但你的方向正確，所以繼續努力。
track record: The company has a good track record of delivering packages on time, so many customers trust it.
這家公司在準時送達包裹方面有良好的過往紀錄，所以很多顧客信任它。
track a package: You can track a package online by entering the number printed on your receipt.
你可以輸入收據上印的號碼，在網路上追蹤包裹。
